\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb}
\newcommand{\R}{\mathbb{R}}
\newcommand{\norm}[1]{\left\lVert #1 \right\rVert}
\DeclareMathOperator{\grad}{grad}
\def\half{\tfrac{1}{2}}
\newcommand{\ket}[1]{|#1\rangle}
\begin{document}
\section{Notation}
Let $x \in \R^n$ and write $\norm{x}$ for its length. The gradient is $\grad f$, and
the kinetic energy is $\half m v^2$. A state is $\ket{\psi}$.
\begin{equation}
  \norm{x}^2 = \sum_{i=1}^n x_i^2
\end{equation}
\end{document}
